acceptedInterpretation: U-01b means an independent PRE_CERT CertificationWindow that chokes done_required_validate, validate --full, and doneRequiredCommands. It consumes B-3f3d FINALIZED inventory plus merge/clean/coverage facts. It does not implement U-01a, U-02, U-03, U-04, U-05, or freshness relaxation.
notes: Collision considered: (1) fold PRE_CERT into B-3f3d inventory receipts, rejected because inventory authority is completeness-only; (2) prompt-only PRE_CERT, rejected by the process-fact contract; (3) wait for B-3f3d DONE before starting, rejected by the operator request to start now with fail-closed if inventory APIs are absent.
